title: Woodfired Kangaroo Tikka Masala
description: A twist on the classic Indian dish, featuring woodfired kangaroo in a rich and creamy tomato sauce.
instructions: Preheat the woodfired grill to medium-high heat.
Season the kangaroo fillet with salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Grill the kangaroo for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let the kangaroo rest for 5 minutes before slicing it into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the skillet oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion, ginger, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the cumin, coriander, and garam masala to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato puree to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the yogurt and cook until the sauce has thickened.
Add the cooked kangaroo to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Serve the kangaroo tikka masala over basmati rice or with naan bread.
